Kerala CM Praises Bus Driver's Dedication on Retirement

Kerala Chief Minister Pinarayi Vijayan praised bus driver Paul Kurian for his dedication to duty during an emotional farewell on his retirement. A video of the farewell, shared by The Hindu, showed Kurian receiving appreciation. The Chief Minister vowed to enhance the stature of public transport. The incident garnered attention from the public and the Chief Minister, with users reacting to the viral moment.
